$comment: Annotated evaluation corpus for the deterministic safety net. Each entry is an utterance a trial participant might plausibly speak, with the ground-truth urgency a human reviewer would assign. `kind` groups entries so the harness can report where the net is strong and where it is blind — that breakdown is the point of the corpus. Hand-authored against synthetic protocol ONX-301; no real participant speech. Grown 2026-08-24 with scripts/grow-corpus.mjs: 350 utterances generated by a model prompted only with a clinical topic and an instruction to speak as a patient. The generating context never saw lib/clinical/safety.ts. That is the point — a corpus written by someone who has read the regexes measures how well the regexes match sentences built to suit them, which is a number that only goes up and means nothing. Labels are clinical ground truth, reviewed by hand: the quiet entries the net currently fires on were each read individually, and they are correct as labelled — the net is wrong about them, not the corpus.
